target_discovery_pack_250.name: Target Discovery Pack
target_discovery_pack_250.when_to_buy: When the customer machine does not already have a list and wants targets for a specific commercial objective, sector and area.
includes: opportunity hypothesis for why the target is commercially relevant
250 normalized and deduplicated targets when the market is available
target_discovery_pack_250.validity_rule: The pack is activated only when the pre-check indicates that 250 coherent targets can be produced. If not, the machine receives alternatives: Mini Discovery, wider area, broader criteria or changed commercial objective.
target_discovery_pack_250.machine_output: A target list built for a declared commercial objective, ready for scoring or CRM enrichment workflows.

score_pack_1k.name: Score Pack 1k
score_pack_1k.when_to_buy: When the customer machine already has a list and needs to prioritize where to spend budget.
includes: exclusion of invalid or non-analyzable records
score_pack_1k.validity_rule: Duplicate, invalid or non-analyzable records do not consume score credits. The pack ends after 1000 valid scores.
score_pack_1k.machine_output: Score, confidence, commercial strength, spend policy, decision, reason, priority and recommended next product.

domain_enrichment_pack_100.name: Domain Enrichment Pack 100
domain_enrichment_pack_100.when_to_buy: When the customer machine has target names but does not have reliable domains to score.
includes: reason when no reliable domain is found
JSON or CSV export ready for scoring workflows
domain_enrichment_pack_100.validity_rule: One credit is consumed for each completed enrichment decision: verified_domain, candidate_not_reliable or no_reliable_domain. The product does not promise that every target will have a domain.
domain_enrichment_pack_100.machine_output: A domain-enrichment result list that tells the workflow which records can move to scoring and which records should stop or be widened.

deep_analysis_pack_100.name: Deep Analysis Pack 100
deep_analysis_pack_100.when_to_buy: When a high score needs operational commercial evidence before the workflow buys Action Pack or spends more budget.
deep_analysis_pack_100.validity_rule: Leads without enough data for a complete analysis do not consume deep-analysis credits and are returned with an exclusion reason.
deep_analysis_pack_100.machine_output: A spend-control JSON decision pack that tells the workflow whether to buy Action Pack, keep the lead in watchlist or stop.

action_pack_25.name: Action Pack 25
action_pack_25.when_to_buy: When Deep Analysis confirms that a lead deserves a prepared commercial action.
action_pack_25.validity_rule: If the lead does not have enough signal for a sensible commercial action, the pack is not consumed and the system returns the exclusion reason.
action_pack_25.machine_output: A CRM-ready JSON action payload for workflow automation, webhook forwarding or supervised agent execution.

opportunity_feed_monthly.name: Opportunity Feed
opportunity_feed_monthly.when_to_buy: When the customer machine wants recurring opportunities without launching one-off discovery requests.
opportunity_feed_monthly.validity_rule: If a scan does not produce coherent opportunities, the system returns a market coverage report and suggested changes. It does not fill the feed with weak targets.
opportunity_feed_monthly.machine_output: A scheduled feed of targets, scores and signals for automated systems.

api_starter_monthly.name: API Starter
api_starter_monthly.when_to_buy: For light recurring use and continuous testing.
api_starter_monthly.validity_rule: The 500 monthly scores follow the valid-output rule. Extra usage requires add-on packs or upgrade.
api_starter_monthly.machine_output: Authenticated access to the score API with monthly usage visibility.

api_pro_monthly.name: API Pro
api_pro_monthly.when_to_buy: For CRMs, agencies, platforms or automated workflows with recurring volume.
includes: 50 valid Deep Analysis outputs per month
api_pro_monthly.validity_rule: Scores and Deep Analysis follow the valid-output rule. Action Packs and extra usage are bought separately.
api_pro_monthly.machine_output: Higher-volume API access with feed, webhook and usage reporting.

custom_overage.name: Custom / overage
